summary: reach warm-up targets and write instagram comments
changes: instagram comments now work for most niches, using short, safe replies that never copy the caption and never repeat in a session.
posts from your own keyword search count toward likes and follows even when the caption does not repeat the keyword.
default targets now match what a session can really do, for example 60 likes, 18 follows and 7 comments in 40 minutes.
one comment box hiccup no longer turns comments off for the rest of the session.
replace the files in your original extension folder, reload the extension and reopen warm-up.
